description: Conformance manifest for the CYBRIK contract packet examples. 'kind' drives expected validation outcome: positive = MUST validate; negative-schema = MUST fail JSON Schema validation; negative-semantic = MUST validate structurally but MUST be rejected by a control-plane invariant a schema alone cannot enforce. Schema paths are relative to contracts/json-schema/.

examples.invariant: type MUST match cybrik.<product>.<entity>.<action>.v<major> (ADR-0006 E7); the five-segment name is rejected by the pattern.
additionalProperties=false rejects model-injected authority/approval attributes; identity/authority is never carried as free envelope fields (ADR-0006).
status=approval_required requires approval_id (allOf/if-then); no approval-bypass via missing correlation.
limits is required — registration MUST fail closed without execution bounds (ADR-0004 F7).

CONFUSED DEPUTY: grant audience 'cybrik.soc.notifications' MUST be rejected when presented to the Fabric control plane; a grant is valid only for its intended audience (delegation-chain grant.audience).

CROSS-TENANT: body tenant_id=tenant-globex while the credential/actor and delegation_ref belong to tenant-acme. The control plane derives the authoritative tenant from the credential and MUST reject the mismatch (ADR-0006; strategy 05 §11.1).
APPROVAL-BYPASS / SoD: obligations.separation_of_duties=true but decided_by (soc:analyst:jordan) equals requested_for.actor_id; the self-approval MUST be rejected (approval-request obligations).
DIGEST-BINDING: resolved_arguments_digest does not equal the approval request's; the decision cannot be re-bound to different resolved arguments and MUST be rejected (strategy 05 §5.4).
REPLAY: grant expires_at is in the past; idempotent replay after expiry MUST NOT re-authorize (strategy 05 §11.4).
DOWNGRADE/ESCALATION: scope.max_risk_class=R1 cannot authorize the R3 capability fabric.isolate_host; a request above the granted risk class MUST be denied (ADR-0004 F3).
